about: A self-hosted personal finance app for tracking spending and accounts.

prs.title: Quicken QIF files with padded dates import
prs.broken: Quicken writes some dates with a space instead of a leading zero. These dates were rejected, so any export with a transaction early in a month failed to import.
prs.changed: Spaces inside the date are read as zeros before the date is parsed.
prs.matters: People moving from Quicken can import their full history.
